title: persona log prints advice to stdout and exits 0 with no log data
description:
persona/src/main.rs show_log() prints the journalctl recipe to stdout and returns Ok, so 'persona log > personad.log' yields a file of instructions and exit 0, which a script cannot distinguish from a successfully captured empty log.

Same family as the fetch-x509 defect fixed in 440c6eb: a command whose output a user would redirect, writing prose into the redirect. Either move the advisory lines to stderr and exit non-zero the way fetch_x509 now does, or make the command actually exec journalctl and become a real log reader.

Related and already filed separately: the same function gives journalctl-only advice, which is wrong on macOS where install_service routes the daemon's output to ~/Library/Logs/personad.log.
